summary: Attackers hijacked the BonkFun memecoin launchpad domain and deployed a wallet drainer that displayed a fake compliance or terms prompt. Users who signed the message unknowingly authorized malicious transactions allowing attackers to drain funds from connected wallets.
user_mistake: signed a wallet prompt on a compromised website domain
prevention: avoid signing wallet prompts on websites during security incidents / verify official platform domain status before interacting with wallet requests
